description: A single undated scrape of OYO (Indian budget-hotel aggregator) listing cards: one row per property with hotel name (Oyo/Flagship/Collection O/Super/Capital O brand tiers), locality string, INR nightly list price, headline discount percent and review count. Despite the job-card slug, the sample is not Mumbai-only: the location suffix is Bangalore (149), Delhi/New Delhi (~140), Kolkata (102), Mumbai (20) plus locality-only strings (Karol Bagh, Paharganj, Mahipalpur), so it is a four-metro cross-section; median price INR 1,599, median discount 65%, max review count 7,398. Source is the author's own scrape (Cleaning.ipynb), MIT licence, 0 stars. For ABNB an analyst could use it only as a static reference for the Indian budget-lodging price and discount structure (list-vs-effective price wedge ~65%) that Airbnb's APAC supply competes against; no time dimension, so no nowcast or point-in-time use.
issues: Slug/one_line mislabel: dataset covers Bangalore, Delhi, Kolkata and Mumbai, not Mumbai alone. No date or scrape timestamp anywhere (repo push 2026-02-27 is the only bound). id column NaN for 331 rows (concatenated scrapes). rating is a review count, not a star rating. OYO's terms of service may not permit scraping; the data was scraped by the repo author, not by us, and we did not run any scraper. Very small, no vintage, no ABNB relevance beyond a static competitor price reference.
